notes.title: 🌏 Big Update: Beautiful World Mode, Labor Costs & More!
notes.content:
Hey Traders,

We’re thrilled to bring you the Beautiful World update—packed with features to expand your Trade Conquest experience. This update will affect save files, so prepare for a fresh start to enjoy everything new and avoid any issues!

Key Features Coming:
Beautiful World Game Mode (New!)

 Customize nations before playing: Edit Territories, GDP, Population, Names, Traits and much more.
 10 Additional Historical Nations have been added to this list that can only been edited and played as through this Game Mod. Includes Confederate States, Soviet Union and Third Reich.
 Perfect for alternate histories or challenge runs to create your own Beautiful World. 
 Note: Separate save slot | No achievements or ranking.

Dynamic Labor Costs
Maintenance costs now scale with GDPPC:

 High-income (Developed Economy) (50K+ GDPPC): +50% labor costs
 Middle-income (Developed Economy) (15K-50K): Gradual 0% to +50%
 Lower-middle (Emerging Economy) (4K-15K): -25% to 0% discount
 Low-income (Undeveloped Economy) (<4K): Permanent -25% discount 
Nations with strong Labor Unions like Nordic nations now start with "Labor Union" law (+10% Labor Costs and -0.1 monthly unrest in all provinces/territories).
Complimentary new research further reduces unrest by 0.05.

This is to help give the feel of "Cheaper Labor" in underdeveloped nations and higher expenses in "Developed Nations" with its own pros and cons. 

New Ranking
World Ranking for Economy Win-Con: New World Order based on the least number of days taken to achieve Economy Win. 

Quality of Life

 Market Search Bar: Find resources instantly (exact spelling required).
 Strict Resource Locking: Locked resources at the Market Tab won’t sell— even via auto-sell/liquidation. (✓/✗)
 Political Map Colors: Num-9 now swaps both map and bill colors for left/right leanings.


Accessibility & Immersion
German & Spanish language support added. Options in Main menu and Game menu. 
Other languages in the works. Let us know your interests as a Comment or in our Discord!
New current events reflecting modern times.

Bug Fixes & Balancing
AI combat patterns reworked.
Military Resources Demand based on Wars increased.
Private Security now provides an additional 0.01 Monthly Unrest Reduction
HUD adjustments to better fit languages. 
And as always, we’ve squashed bugs and fine-tuned other mechanics for gameplay.

⚠️ Important: This update will affect saved games. We recommend wrapping up ongoing campaigns before updating to avoid any issues.

notes.title: 🌍 Update: United Europe Movement, New Laws & More!
notes.content:
Hey Traders,

We’re excited to bring you another update packed with new features, improvements, and fixes! This update focuses on deepening the political and economic systems in Trade Conquest, while also addressing performance and stability. Here’s everything you need to know:

United Europe Movement:

 A new “United Europe Movement” has been added under the “Business” province tab.
 This movement is only available for EU member states and can be accessed in their Capital Province.
 Fund the movement to accelerate its progress toward unifying the EU into a single nation.
 Success requires high support from each member state, which shifts monthly.

New EU Candidate:
Georgia has been added as an EU candidate starting December 14, 2023.

New Social Laws for Continental Europe:
Two new social laws have been added for Continental European nations:

 Become an EU Candidate: Apply for EU membership if your nation is not already a candidate.
 Join a United Europe: Become part of a successful United Europe movement, giving up your Head of State status if applicable.

Note: These additions are not available in the “End of Empires” game mode.

Debt-to-GDP Unrest Consequences:

High debt-to-GDP ratios now have negative unrest consequences:

 2x GDP: +0.02 Unrest
 5x GDP: +0.05 Unrest
 10x GDP+: +0.1 Unrest

Nations with high unrest, high debt, and civil war can now “Collapse”, leading to a government change and the potential loss of provinces to more stable neighbors.

Performance Improvements:

 A slight lighting change has been implemented for better performance.
 The clicking-on-province animation has been removed to improve performance.
 As well as other adjustments in the hopes of more efficient ram use. 

Bug Fixes & Balancing:
As always, we’ve addressed several bugs and made balance adjustments to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

**If you're in the middle of a playthrough and it is going well, do Not update to avoid any issues as this update is not a necessity. This does add to your saves. 

We hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements! Dive in, explore the changes, and let us know what you think.

Thank you for your continued support, and happy trading!

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: 🌍 Major Update is Live: GDP Overhaul, Modern Politics & More!
notes.content:
Hello Traders,

The major update is now live, and it’s packed with features that will transform your Trade Conquest experience! From a reworked GDP system to modernized politics and a sleek new “Phone” interface, there’s something for everyone. As a reminder, this update will affect save files, so dive in fresh to experience all the new changes (New game is a must for things to work correctly).

Here’s everything you need to know:

Reworked GDP Growth System:
GDP growth is now calculated on a per-province basis, with its effects being added or subtracted monthly. Multiple factors influence it:

1. Industry Tiers: Higher tiers (starting at T2) provide greater GDP growth, while Tier 1 provides none. 

2. Inflation:

 0% to -10% Inflation: No effect on GDP growth.
 Greater than 0% to 5% Inflation: The sweet spot for optimal GDP growth.
 Greater than 5% to under 10% Inflation: No effect on GDP growth.
 10%+ Inflation: Begins to negatively impact GDP growth, with significant penalties at very high levels.

3. Production Bonuses: Laws that provide production bonuses will increase GDP growth per province, while negative production bonuses will decrease it.

4. Province Stability: Provinces can experience negative growth with high unrest.

5. National Growth: Achieving 10%+ yearly growth (rare and often through conquest or by smaller nations) will initially spike inflation but balance over time.

6. New Laws: Laws are a great way to increase GDP growth if you can balance the negative effects.

Modernized Politics:
The Politics tab is now divided into Economy, Social, and Security with a new display bar showing how much Influence you currently have for the selected nation from the maximum. A new mechanic introduces “The People” and “Corporate” support:

Pass laws aligned with either group to gain their support.
Maintain 75+ support from one group for a 5% monthly influence bonus, or 15% if both groups are at 75+. Support is reduced over time. 

To pass the “Enabling Act” and become head of state, you now also need at least 75+ support from either “The People” or “Corporate” groups, in addition to the previous requirements.

Economy Win Condition:
A new victory path! Achieve 55% of the world’s GDP before any other nation to claim economic dominance. An achievement has been added to celebrate this milestone.

New Phone who dis?:

 The new Phone UI replaces the Current Events and Notifications system.
 It consolidates all current events and notifications into one place.
 View the date, clear notifications individually or all at once, and revisit past events.
 The Phone icon glows blue when new information is available.

Access it via the bottom-right button. Note: This does not replace general pop-ups, only current events and notifications.

New Playable Nations:
USA, Russia, China, and India are now playable starting nations in the “New World Order” game mode. Lead these global superpowers to dominance!

New Disaster Categories:
Disasters are now categorized into:

 Recent Disasters (mostly natural disasters with it's affects lasting 3 months),
 Pandemics ( with it's affects lasting 6 months),
 Vermin Infestations (localized but persistent, will start removal once unrest has been reduced).

Dynamic Events:
New “Avatar” events to better highlight character backgrounds and more dynamic event options to shape your story. So choose wisely. 

Production in Tons:
Production values are now displayed in Tons to match market prices, with storage amounts adjusted accordingly for a more intuitive experience.

Quality of Life Additions:

 New “Diplomacy” Button: Quickly navigate to a nation’s diplomacy tab from the Province menu.
 Force Liquidation: Sell all resources at once in the Market Tab for a fee. (Hover for additional details)
 Disband Missiles: Decommission ICBMs and Hypersonic Missiles from your reserves as head of state.
 Music Tab: Enjoy additional tracks to keep the Jazz and Chill vibes alive during long sessions.
 Right-Click Ocean: Close nation information windows by right-clicking the ocean, just like left-clicking closes tabs.
 Window Mode Improvements: Keeps music playing when clicking outside the game.
 Bulldoze Flexibility: Bulldoze different tier industries in sequence, including all higher tiers.
 New Climate: “Monsoon Tropical” added to better represent South East Asia’s spice trade.


Bug Fixes & Balancing:
 Crude Oil and Gas: Because of their importance in electricity, heating and a cornerstone in so many higher tier resources, Crude Oil and Natural Gas have been added to the "Inflation Average" list. Their demand in your Home Market will now affect your inflation.
 Inflation Capped: Now ranges from -10% to 1000%.

As always, we’ve squashed bugs and fine-tuned gameplay for a smoother experience.

We’re thrilled to bring these changes to you and can’t wait to see how you shape the world in your vision.

Thank you for your continued support, and happy trading!

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Streamlined Gameplay and Exciting Additions: New Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’re excited to bring you the latest update for Trade Conquest, packed with improvements, new features, and balances based on your feedback. Here’s a breakdown of what’s included:

Nation Selection Improvements: Choose Random or Modern Alliances for unique challenges, with added info and confirmation for smoother selection.
Diplomacy Enhancements: A new “Target” toggle prioritizes sieges against specific nations when waging war on multiple fronts in the "Diplomacy Tab".
Counterfeit Operations: Maxed out at 50% counterfeit inflation- to increase enemy inflation, with detailed tracking under the “Oval Office”- “Taxes,” and nation info widget (Right click).
New Countermeasures: Use the added “Counterfeit” bill to combat inflation from counterfeit Lyfe within your nation, which will now update monthly (instead of yearly), impacting performance slightly. Very high inflation also triggers social unrest events.
Destabilization Type: You will now be able to see what type of “Destabilization” your enemy is trying to carry out and if your “Counter Terrorism” was successful in stopping it. This includes destabilization through increasing unrest, counterfeit Lyfe and market manipulation. 
Army Adjustments: Speed halved, and splitting inherits stance choices.
Resource Updates: Fish is now exclusive to polar climates and coastal provinces, removed from tropical rainforests and grasslands.
UI and Monitor Fixes: Optimized for diverse monitor sizes.
More Balances and Bug Fixes: Ensuring smoother gameplay and better immersion.

This update reflects our commitment to making Trade Conquest a dynamic, engaging experience. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re always looking to improve further.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm! We hope you enjoy the new features, challenges and strategies to explore.

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: A Week of Trade Conquest! Thank You & Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
To all the players of Trade Conquest, thank you for your incredible support since our launch on the 17th! Your feedback, reviews, and enthusiasm mean the world to us. Seeing the community embrace the game and share your thoughts has been amazing—we truly appreciate every single review and comment.

Updates & Improvements
Based on your feedback, we’ve rolled out some updates to make the game even better:

Resource UI Filter: You can now filter out UI resources by marking them as “Close.” These won’t appear again unless you build another industry producing them or purchase them on the market.

New Ministries: Introducing the Ministry of Transportation, Ministry of Labor, and Ministry of Security. Once you become Head of State, these ministries can be activated to help grow your nation automatically using the National Treasury. This feature is especially useful in the late game for managing larger territories without excessive micromanagement. (Under Oval Office)

Static Events: We’ve added a couple static events for the end of 2024, reflecting the current times and keeping the gameplay immersive.

AID Costs Adjustment: Aid costs now scale more aggressively with GDP differences. The stronger the nation you’re aiding, the higher their requirements will be.

Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Improvements: Various tweaks to enhance gameplay and polish the experience.
Your feedback has been vital in shaping these updates, and we’re committed to continuing improvements as we move forward.

Happy Holidays! 🎉 
From everyone at GrandPaw Games, we wish you a wonderful holiday season. Thank you for playing, and we’re excited to see where Trade Conquest takes you next!

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: 🚀 Major Demo Update – The Final Countdown to Full Release! 🌍
notes.content:
Greetings, strategists!

We’re excited to roll out what may be the last update to the demo before the full release of the game. This update introduces cutting-edge mechanics, game-changing features, and more depth to your grand strategy experience. The demo remains limited to 30 minutes of playtime, but here’s what’s new:

🌟 New Additions: Hypersonic Missiles, ICBMs, and Ballistic Defense
Hypersonic Missile and ICBM Systems Added:
🔧 Includes 4 exclusive resources: Hypersonic Body (T4), Nuclear Warhead (T4), Hypersonic Missile (T5), and ICBM (T5).
🛠️ Assemble these under the “Special Forces” tab. Just like military units, they will have maintenance costs.
🛡️ Steel Dome Ballistic Defense and Silo Mechanics added—prepare wisely!
⚔️ Launch these powerful weapons (with appropriate research and resources) against enemy nations by pressing N/M when at war.

Hypersonic Missiles: Cause Unrest and destroy random investments unless blocked by Steel Dome defenses.
ICBMs: Devastate provinces and international relations. Defended strikes wipe out military forces; undefended strikes obliterate investments, population, and resources in surrounding provinces.
💥 Superpower AI now utilizes Hypersonic Missiles during wars for an intense and realistic challenge!

🌀 Dynamic Events and Features
Province Special Events: Unpredictable occurrences that will challenge your strategies.
Weather Manipulation: Build and activate special buildings to summon Heat, Rain, Snow, or Tornadoes, with the option to intensify effects.
Pandemics: Introduced with 3 severity levels (Low, Medium, High) and 9 unique virus types. Each impacts resource demand, Unrest, and mortality rates. Watch as contagion spreads every 45 days, impacting provinces and beyond!
New Research Tree Options: Expanded branches for both Social and Military advancements.
🤝 Improved Diplomacy & War Assistance
Army Resource Donations: Help allied nations in war by donating Army Resources (tanks, artillery, etc.) via the Close Relations Agreement (unlockable in the Business Province Tab). Donations convert to armies but can’t exceed the recipient’s manpower limit.
⚙️ Balances and Fixes
As always, this update includes numerous tweaks and improvements to gameplay balance to ensure a smoother experience.

Your journey as a master of strategy is about to get even more intense. Let us know what you think of these updates as we prepare for the full release! 🚩

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Demo Update: New Resources, Industry Tools & Research Limitations!

The new Trade Conquest demo update is here, adding exciting gameplay features to enhance your experience!

Improved UI & Tooltips: Hover over any resource icon in the Trade Tab and UI resources to view detailed tooltips and info—perfect for deep, informed decisions.

Plus, this update includes other bug fixes and improvements for smoother gameplay. Check out the demo and let us know how these changes impact your strategy!

Best,

notes.title: Get Ready for the Playtest: Power, Strategy, and Economic Domination
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

We’re excited to announce the upcoming Trade Conquest playtest! As you prepare to dive into the game, here are some key features and mechanics to familiarize yourself with, spread across several important tabs. For more detailed information, head to the Knowledge Tab inside the game.

Provinces:
Inflation and Taxes: Purchases within a province are influenced by national inflation and corporate taxes.
GDP Boost: Resources and industries increase provincial GDP, minus taxes and inflation.
Storage: Be mindful of how much you can store—excess resources go to waste.
Projects/Investments: Expensive but impactful long-term investments.
Flags: Display ownership of resource lots; your avatar will show on your owned lots.
Building Times: Ranges from 8 to 68 months depending on tier.
Trade Tab:
Markets: Most markets are open unless events disrupt them.
Sell Carefully: Lack of resources will cost you 4x the base value on auto-purchases.
Logistics Fees: Included with all purchases.
Fluctuation: Flooding markets with resources lowers demand and prices.
Highlighted Resources: Easily spot what you produce in markets.
Demand Fluctuation: Events and wars significantly affect demand.
Research Tab:
All research knowledge can be acquired from the Investment window in each province or by passing certain bills.
Business Research: Improves maintenance, building, and purchasing efficiency.
Social Research: Enhances production, influence, and unrest management.
Military Research: Increases unit effectiveness, production speed, and other key stats.
Politics Tab:
Political Leaning: Government types impact the laws and business environment.
Influence: Use money to gain influence and pass beneficial laws.
Consolidated Power: Pass the “Enabling Act” to become Head of State, giving you full control over your nation but with added risks.
Military Tab:
Effectiveness & Manpower: Track unit strength and available manpower.
Maintenance Costs: Units cost upkeep whether in reserves or active.
Create Units & Armies: Requires resources, and units appear at the capital.
Army View: Provides full details on your forces, including traits, moves, and autonomy settings.
Diplomacy Tab:
Relations & War: Manage alliances, declare war, and give aid to improve relationships.
Alliances: You can have 1-2 allies, and they’ll support you in war.
Sanctions: Harm relations and cut off market access.
Oval Office:
GDP and Population Stats: GDP per capita and unrest metrics influence immigration and workforce.
Unrest: Manage unrest to avoid serious workforce reductions and negative effects.
Debt and Inflation: Pay national debt to improve inflation over time.
For those looking to dive deeper, the Knowledge Tab has a wealth of additional information to explore.

Be sure to join our Discord for feedback and to share your experiences during the playtest:
Discord Invite

Best,
GrandPaw Games

notes.title: Unveil the Resource Secrets Hidden in Every Province’s Climate!
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

We’re excited to share more about how climates will affect resource availability in Trade Conquest. Our game offers a dynamic approach to resource distribution, where provinces will be randomly assigned up to 12 different resources, depending on the climate. Although a few exceptions may allow some preset resources in unexpected climates, most provinces will follow the guidelines below—so be sure to plan accordingly as you expand!

Additionally, keep in mind that the further you build from your capital, the higher your transportation costs will be. Every playthrough brings unique challenges as you won’t know exactly what to expect with each new game.

Here’s a breakdown of where you can expect to find resources based on the climate:

Gold, Silver, Iron, Nickel, Titanium, Copper, Calcium, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Bauxite, Diamonds
